subtitle.en: Open the lid. Pick each garment. Load the washer.
subtitle.zh: 打开机盖，逐件抓取衣物，放进洗衣机。

description.en: A compact top-loader, a laundry basket and a pile of clothes on the table. The wrist camera surveys the load; the gripper opens the lid by its handle, then transfers cotton T-shirts, a knit jacket and denim trousers one at a time. Fabric drapes and falls in MuJoCo.
description.zh: 小型波轮洗衣机、衣篮，以及桌面上的一叠衣服。腕部摄像头观察衣物，夹爪握住把手开盖，再逐件转运棉质 T 恤、针织外套和牛仔裤。布料在 MuJoCo 中垂落、折叠和下落。

origin.en: MuJoCo deformable fabric · simulated wrist perception · planned pinch grasps. Browser concept; hardware handling needs validation.
origin.zh: MuJoCo 可变形布料 · 模拟腕部感知 · 规划夹取。浏览器概念演示，实际硬件处理仍需验证。

name.zh: 将衣篮内衣物放入洗衣机

description.en: Open the lid and load three basket garments, one by one.
description.zh: 打开机盖，逐件放入衣篮里的三件衣物。

name.zh: 清理桌面并放入全部衣物

description.en: Load all six garments from the basket and table, one at a time.
description.zh: 从衣篮和桌面逐件抓取，将全部六件衣物放进洗衣机。
